configurations.name: orbital-sandbox
runtimeArgs: cd app && APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD="$(cat .local/sandbox/data/.admin-password)" APP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin APP_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.local/sandbox/data" APP_ENABLE_DEMO_SEED=1 APP_DEMO_FILES_ROOT="$PWD/.local/sandbox/library" APP_OPEN_SIGNUP=0 APP_COOKIE_SECURE=0 PORT=4300 node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n server,client "node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs server/index.ts" "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 5173 --strictPort"
